_REVIEW_REOPENED_AND_CLOSED_THIS.why: a7 timed a SHADOW of the production scorer. Its loop called sketch_forward_kl_mean_batch without weights and discarded the result, so it omitted active.prediction_weights_for, the weighted reduction, the values.tolist() host transfer that IS production's synchronization, the per-subtype collection and domain_balanced_score. It also prebuilt the reference sketches before timing, so the cache fill -- operator work inside every real apply() -- was priced at zero. And `260 x per-candidate` was never the quantity the cost table holds: BeamSearch._expand_one records operator_seconds around impl.execute(ctx), the WHOLE invocation.

_authorizes: nothing. ENGINEERING evidence from the engineering book, which does not transfer into the formal one. Formal D1 remains NOT AUTHORIZED, phase_d1 is not in funds_formal_sessions_of, and neither the formal allowance, the project cap nor the $30.00 envelope was changed.
_review_reopened_this: An independent review of prep/d-series-topk-tail@bd70a165 reopened the adoption because the old tail arithmetic was invalid at the numerical edge. The tail was reconstructed as `1 - sum(support)`, which crosses float32 resolution once the support holds nearly all the mass -- the measured support mass reached 1.000001 -- and the code then DROPPED the tail term whenever either mass rounded to zero, when only a zero REFERENCE mass may make a forward-KL term vanish. I had classified the resulting single violation as a 'bounded open numerical observation'; it was a defect, and the 1.000001 in my own report was the evidence. The superseded findings are preserved at closeout.SUPERSEDED_BY_REVIEW.json and in runs/a1..a3.

_superseded_extrapolations._meaning: the two withdrawn figures bracket the truth in OPPOSITE directions, which is why neither could be reasoned about without measuring. a7 omitted real work AND multiplied by a tail-outlier max; the over-count won by 11.0%. a6 was 69.9% high from its own synchronizations. a7's MEAN happened to land within 1.0%, which is luck and not a method.

E_production_cost._the_phase_split_is_NOT_attributed: `split_is_attributed` is False in both profiles' operator timing, which is correct and deliberate: no synchronizations were inserted. The consequence is that `ablated_seconds` and `distortion_seconds` are NOT a clean forward/reduction split -- without a sync the asynchronous forward's tail is billed to whichever phase forces the next synchronization, which here is the reduction's host transfer. Their SUM is sound; neither alone may be quoted as that phase's cost. a6 is the record of the attributed split and it prices nothing.
E_production_cost._what_is_measured: the quantity `BeamSearch._expand_one` records as `operator_seconds`: a wall clock around `impl.execute(ctx)`, covering packing, the reference-sketch cache fill, all 260 candidate subsets over 8 rounds, the greedy bookkeeping and the child construction. Nothing is extrapolated from a per-candidate figure and no fixed term is added back, because one invocation already contains both.
E_production_cost._why_the_treatment_arm: both D1 arms reach the same weighted reducer, and a $0 preflight MEASURED that only the treatment hands it a weight tensor on the real mixtures ([3, 308] with 665/924 positions nonzero; the control's prediction_weights_for returns None). So the treatment is the more expensive arm and bounds both, and the driver refuses to spend if that ever stops being true.

repair.infinities: a zero candidate tail against a non-zero reference tail is +inf and is PRESERVED; the dynamic 'degenerate' branch is gone and `has_tail` is structural (K < V)
repair.masking: `nan_to_num(posinf=0)` removed from the batched mean; masking happens before the multiply, so a padded position contributes zero and a VALID +inf survives
repair.ownership: the reducers own the fp32 tensor they mask -- `.float()` aliases an fp32 input and would have destroyed the caller's cached reference block
repair.tail: computed from the COMPLEMENT's own logits -- mask the support to -inf and reduce the rest against the same log_z -- so no cancellation exists to lose and the partition's two masses sum to one by construction
